headlines.title: Trump says he has secured a vast U.S. stake in Venezuelan oil industry
headlines.summary: The plan involves the United States taking more direct control over Venezuelan reserves as crime and steep logistical challenges discourage private investors.

headlines.title: At least 540 killed in floods; search on for hundreds missing at Nepal-China border
headlines.summary: Fears of further flooding complicated recovery efforts, as authorities searched for people missing after floods struck the Himalayan border between Nepal and China.

headlines.title: Trump’s grab for Greenland rattles Iceland, which considers joining E.U.
headlines.summary: Iceland will decide whether to restart talks on joining the European Union in a referendum on Saturday, with President Donald Trump's threat to annex Greenland a motivating factor.

headlines.title: Volkswagen CEO warns German workers of sweeping layoffs to come
headlines.summary: The automaker, one of the nation’s biggest employers, could shed tens of thousands of jobs amid global market shifts driven by electrification, AI and autonomous driving.

headlines.title: Uganda declared Ebola-free even as Congo faces deadly, fast-growing epidemic
headlines.summary: Uganda's final Ebola patient was discharged from hospital care on July 16.

headlines.title: Iceland heads to polls in knife-edge referendum on restarting EU talks
headlines.summary: Amid economic and security challenges, Iceland is holding a referendum more than a decade after pausing accession talks.

headlines.title: Ecuador sentences ex-president Moreno to five years in jail in bribery case
headlines.summary: Lenin Moreno, 73, has also been permanently barred from holding any public office in the future.

headlines.title: Nepal and China resume flood rescue as death toll surpasses 600
headlines.summary: Rescue operations have resumed after a brief pause, but experts caution of danger from a newly formed lake.

headlines.title: Guinea-Bissau votes on a stronger presidency: What’s at stake?
headlines.summary: The proposed constitution would give the president more power and reshape parliament and elections.

headlines.title: Trump announces ‘biggest oil deal in world history’ with Venezuela
headlines.summary: US president says deal secures majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of proven oil reserves in Venezuela.

headlines.title: Trump says U.S. has entered deal with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
headlines.summary: President Trump says his administration has entered a sweeping agreement with Venezuela that could give the U.S. access to vast amounts of the South American country's untapped oil reserves, at cost.

headlines.title: Sae Joon Park, a Purple Heart veteran who self-deported, receives pardon
headlines.summary: His removal order was triggered by two convictions from over 15 years ago, when he struggled with untreated PTSD. New York's governor said Park earned a "second chance through rehabilitation."

headlines.title: After 6 months of war, Iran's battered regime remains entrenched
headlines.summary: Instead of collapsing, the Iranian regime has dug in its heels and taken an even harder line.

headlines.title: Fed's Kevin Warsh warns inflation is too high, sparking bets rate hikes are coming
headlines.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated his commitment to fighting inflation in a major speech — raising expectations that rate hikes may be coming, though he did not clearly spell out a path going forward.

headlines.title: New Jersey is a fossil hotspot, with answers about the day the dinosaurs died
headlines.summary: Paleontologist Ken Lacovara never expected to find critical fossil data in a New Jersey suburb—let alone info about the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs. His dig site is now a fossil park and museum.

headlines.title: 359 dead, 910 missing in Nepal's floods
headlines.summary: KATHMANDU -- Nepal's National Disaster Risk Reduction Management Authority said that as many as 359 bodies had been recovered from flood-hit areas by Thursday evening, with 910 people still missing.

headlines.title: China's 'grass tech' helps reap rich harvest in Fiji
headlines.summary: SUVA, Fiji — On a stretch of land once scarred by salt, rows of lush green grass now ripple in the Pacific breeze. Just a few years ago, little could grow here.

headlines.title: Tariffs may hit both US, Canada
headlines.summary: Canada's new retaliatory tariffs will deepen the economic pain from its trade fight with the United States, with experts saying both countries will bear the costs.

headlines.title: Moldova eyes expanding cooperation with China
headlines.summary: This year marks the 35th anniversary of the Republic of Moldova's independence, offering an opportunity to reflect on the steady development of Moldova-China relations over the past three and a half decades and to look ahead with confidence to the next stage of the bilateral partnership, said the Moldovan ambassador to China.
